description: Read saved analytics insights for the workspace. May return an empty list. Reading generates nothing (aidelly_generate_analytics_insights does), and saved insights are not limited to the analytics summary date range, so a missing or stale insight is not evidence of a trend. Read-only.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_get_analytics_insights
title: Get Analytics Insights
